quote: May 13th, local time in Bolivia, the groundbreaking ceremony for the Oruro-Challapata Section 1 bidirectional highway project … undertaken by China Railway(中国中铁), was held in Oruro. … The Oruro Highway Project is a project to renovate and expand the Bolivian national road network's Route 01. It mainly involves the construction of a 19.79-kilometer-long, bidirectional four-lane rigid pavement highway. The project is undertaken by a consortium formed by China Railway International and China Railway 7th Bureau Group.
note: Opened EqualOcean 14 May 2024 (CREC Oruro–Challapata 19.79 km groundbreaking).
